title: Password Strength Estimator with Honest Guess Counts
description: Estimates how many guesses an attacker would need for a password using dictionary, pattern and keyboard-walk checks, and explains in plain words why a long passphrase beats a short complex password.

title: Phishing Email Anatomy Trainer
description: Presents real-looking emails with clickable clues such as sender domain mismatches and urgent wording, scores the learner and shows which warning signs they missed most often.

title: Home Network Port Scanner and Exposure Report
description: Scans devices on a home network that the user owns, lists open services in plain language and suggests which ones to close, with clear ethical limits built into the tool.

title: Log-Based Intrusion Detection with Sigma-Style Rules
description: Writes detection rules for brute-force logins and unusual privilege use, runs them over sample authentication logs and measures alert volume, true detections and false alarms.

title: Malware Behaviour Sandbox Report Parser
description: Parses reports from an isolated analysis environment of benign test samples, extracts process, file and network behaviour and groups similar samples by behaviour for an analyst view.

title: Software Dependency Vulnerability Scanner
description: Reads dependency files from a project, matches versions against public advisory data and ranks findings by severity and whether the vulnerable function is actually reachable.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Service with Recovery Codes
description: Builds time-based one-time password login with rate limiting and one-use recovery codes, and tests lockout, clock drift and code reuse cases against a written security checklist.

title: Capture-the-Flag Platform for a Student Club
description: Hosts challenges in isolated containers per team, tracks scores and hints, and prevents cross-team interference, with an operations guide for running a safe event. Includes a checklist for keeping the event legal and safe.
